{{Top|leg}}
The '''physician's code''' was a doctrine around which the core programming of the [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]] was built. The code prevented the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] from refusing to render medical aid to any being in need, unless specifically ordered otherwise by an appropriately authorized operator. The code also prevented the droid from deliberately inflicting harm to an organic being, including a prohibition on entering into combat.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>
